description: Source code for the main React component 'App' of a Tic Tac Toe game, managing game state, UI rendering, and AI interactions.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the Tic Tac Toe game interface.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on the game board cells, updating game state and checking for win/draw conditions.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game board to start a new game with current settings.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: Changes game mode between 'pvp' and 'ai' and resets the game.

methods.name: toggleStarter
methods.description: Switches which player starts first and resets the game.
